Drosera slackii Cheek

Guitar Sundew

Genus
Drosera (sundews), family Droseraceae
Subgenus
Drosera
Section
Ptycnostigma

Original description

First described in 1987:

Drosera slackii Cheek, Kew Bull. 42(3): 738. 1987 [26 Aug 1987]

IPNI record

Range given in the IPNI record of that publication: South Africa (Cape Province).

How well the identifier knows it

Of 19 validation photos of Drosera slackii (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 17. It gave a confident answer for 16 of them, and 14 of those were right.

Only 39 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera aliciae (1 photo)
  • Drosera admirabilis (1 photo)
